cases.scenario: Native supervisor refuses the first batch step after kill-switch engagement; a follow-up keypress is queued in the same batch.
cases.expectedBehavior: Typed COMPUTER_SUPERVISOR_NOT_LIVE refusal with kill-switch guidance; batch halts and follow-up does not dispatch.
cases.observed: code=COMPUTER_SUPERVISOR_NOT_LIVE message=COMPUTER_SUPERVISOR_NOT_LIVE: kill switch engaged Stop and wait for the user. Stop and wait for the user (kill-switch hotkey: Control+Option+Command+Escape). nativeCalls=1 steps=1; hotkey=Control+Option+Command+Escape

cases.scenario: Native supervisor reports COMPUTER_SUSPENDED on the first keypress in a two-step batch.
cases.expectedBehavior: Typed COMPUTER_SUSPENDED refusal; failedStep terminates the batch with no later click dispatch.
cases.observed: code=COMPUTER_SUSPENDED message=COMPUTER_SUSPENDED: session suspended Stop and wait for the user. Stop and wait for the user (kill-switch hotkey: Control+Option+Command+Escape). nativeCalls=1 steps=1

cases.scenario: Screenshot native seam denies screen-recording permission.
cases.expectedBehavior: Action is refused with COMPUTER_PERMISSION_REQUIRED and user-facing permission guidance.
cases.observed: code=COMPUTER_PERMISSION_REQUIRED message=COMPUTER_PERMISSION_REQUIRED: screen recording permission missing The host needs screen-recording or accessibility permission. Ask the user to grant it. nativeScreenshotCalls=1

cases.scenario: A screenshot at displayEpoch 1 is followed by a click while native display epoch is 2.
cases.expectedBehavior: Click is refused with COMPUTER_DISPLAY_STALE and fresh-screenshot guidance.
cases.observed: code=COMPUTER_DISPLAY_STALE message=COMPUTER_DISPLAY_STALE: display epoch changed Capture a fresh screenshot before acting; the display changed since the last screenshot. Capture a fresh screenshot before acting; the display changed since the last screenshot. nativeClickCalls=1

cases.expectedBehavior: All edge/drift coordinates are refused with COMPUTER_COORD_INVALID before native dispatch.

cases.scenario: First native action never resolves; one-second clamped deadline expires before queued follow-up.
cases.expectedBehavior: Typed COMPUTER_CANCELLED timeout refusal; no follow-up dispatch after deadline expiry.
